title: DAY 4 — LESSON 7: UNDERSTANDING THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN CORRECTION AND PERSONAL ATTACK

questions.prompt: What is the main difference between correction and a personal attack?
options: Correction is always pleasant, while personal attacks are always loud
Correction addresses behaviour or performance, while personal attacks degrade the person
Correction can only come from management

questions.prompt: A supervisor says, "You arrived late today. Please ensure you are punctual." What is this?
options: Harassment simply because it feels uncomfortable

questions.prompt: Which statement is clearly a personal attack?
options: You are useless and have no sense.

questions.prompt: What should an employee do if feedback is valid but delivered with insults?
options: Address the genuine concern and raise the inappropriate communication respectfully

questions.prompt: What does the FACT method encourage?
options: Focusing on the words, assessing the issue, considering communication and taking an appropriate step
Assuming every correction is an attack
